content: अन्यतम {%a.%} [अन्य--डतम] (declined like a noun and not a pronoun) One of many, any one out of a large number (with <ab>gen.</ab> or in <ab>comp.</ab>); (जपन्वान्यतमं वेदम् <ls>Ms. 11. 75</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">6. 32</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">32 4</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 22</ls>, <ls n="Y.">3. 253</ls>; अन्यतरान्यतमशब्दौ अव्युत्पन्ने प्रातिपदिके इति कैयटः).
